summary: The web layer wires every HTTP, WebSocket, and LiveView surface of Barkpark: it defines all pipelines, routes, auth hooks, and real-time channels that expose the core CMS — data CRUD, Studio UI, search, media, schemas, plugins — to browsers, the CLI, and the JS SDK.

intentions.title: Enforce hard multi-tenant isolation at every entry point
intentions.evidence: router.ex defines :scoped_api/:scoped_browser/:scoped_mutate pipelines with ResolveWorkspace/ResolveProject plugs; live_scope.ex re-authorizes on every live_patch so cross-tenant navigation is caught in-socket, not just at dead-render; search_channel.ex replicates the same membership gate on WebSocket join

intentions.title: Support fine-grained sharing of read and write surfaces without membership
intentions.evidence: router.ex defines :shared_docs_api, :shared_media_api, :shared_paper_browser, :shared_studio_browser pipelines wrapping RequireShareScope; P4/P5/P7 comments describe docs-read, media-edit-token, and per-item share-link surfaces; ShareController/ShareLinkController routes handle mint/list/revoke; live_scope.ex attaches a :live_scope_readonly gate for share_read grade

intentions.title: Allow plugins to contribute routes at compile time without modifying the host router
intentions.evidence: router/plugins.ex macro reads Registry.collect_routes/1 at compile time and emits Phoenix AST for 8 auth buckets (:admin,:ops,:public,:api,:token,:token_root,:ingest,:public_root); router.ex has 10+ plugin_routes() callsites covering both flat and /w/:ws/p/:proj scoped prefixes; the fresh-install invariant (empty plugins → no routes emitted) is explicitly preserved

intentions.title: Preserve backward compatibility for legacy clients while routing new clients to canonical URLs
intentions.evidence: router.ex keeps /api/documents/:type (legacy TUI), /v1/paperflow/* (back-compat Bulldocs ingest alias), /studio/:dataset (flat→scoped 302), /studio/onixedit/book/:doc_id (LegacyRedirectController), /w/:ws/p/:proj/studio/:dataset (pre-/d/ canonical 302); LegacyDeprecation plug adds deprecation headers

intentions.title: Deliver per-keystroke search over a persistent WebSocket to eliminate per-request TLS overhead
intentions.evidence: search_channel.ex uses a single Phoenix Channel per tenant scope; seq field lets the client discard stale replies; response shape is identical to SearchController.search/2 so clients render identically over HTTP or socket

intentions.title: Provide a versioned API error contract that supports both legacy flat strings and structured violation envelopes
intentions.evidence: error_envelope.ex serializes to v1 (flat string list) or v2 (JSON Pointer keyed violation maps with severity/code/rule) negotiated via Accept-Version header; handles legacy field maps, WI1 violation structs, and plain string lists uniformly

intentions.title: Gate LiveView surfaces with role-differentiated auth hooks that fail closed
intentions.evidence: live_auth.ex defines :admin, :ops, :fetch_api_token on_mount hooks; :admin requires 'admin' permission, :ops accepts 'ops' or 'admin'; failures redirect to /studio or /login with flash; dev environment auto-injects dev token for frictionless local workflow

intentions.title: Scope the Studio URL to workspace/project/dataset to make tenant context visible and bookmarkable
intentions.evidence: router.ex canonical Studio is /w/:ws/p/:proj/d/:dataset/studio; live_scope.ex on_mount resolves from URL params (not session) and re-resolves on every handle_params patch; old /studio/:dataset flat form 302s to the canonical; StudioRedirectController handles legacy_scoped and studio redirects
